title: Scriptura Licence Record
description: The authoritative licence record for a corpus source. Normative source: .clinerules/050-data-licensing.md and ADR-0010. Drives the ingestion licence gate.

applies_to.description: Source registry identifiers this licence record governs. Must be non-empty.

licence.description: The licence exactly as written, including version. Never upgraded, never downgraded by assumption.

share_alike.description: Where true, Scriptura derivatives inherit this licence and are NOT relicensed under Apache 2.0.

share_alike_consequence.description: What share-alike obliges Scriptura to do. Mandatory in substance where share_alike is true.

non_commercial_quarantine.description: Where commercial_use_permitted is false, the dataset and its derivatives are quarantined from commercial distribution.

attribution_text.description: Verbatim. Reproduced exactly in docs/data/attribution/ATTRIBUTIONS.md and in NOTICE.

public_domain_basis.description: Where the licence is a public-domain status: the basis, and any jurisdictional caveat.

layer_split.description: Where licensing_model is 'layered': which component carries which licence.
